name: Compagnie Générale des Établissements Michelin Société en commandite par actions
business_summary: Compagnie Générale des Établissements Michelin Société en commandite par actions engages in the manufacture and sale of tires worldwide. It operates through Automotive & Two-wheel, Road Transportation, and Specialties segments. The company offers connected solutions for business fleets; and licenses car and bicycle accessories, collectibles, and sports and recreational gears. It also provides tire-related services; mobility services, such as road maps and itineraries, mobile apps, and travel guides. The company was incorporated in 1863 and is headquartered in Clermont-Ferrand, France.
